subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable runtime schema and its CLI, Gateway, context-reference, and native-client surfaces as permanent supported core contracts on the 2026.7.1 line?
rationale: Correctness review cannot authorize a broad new persistent data model and cross-surface public contract with long-term migration, support, and compatibility obligations.

options.title: Sponsor and harden
options.body: Adopt the direction after the two exact-head defects, inspectable proof, upgrade safety, and owner-review gates are satisfied.

options.title: Narrow the foundation
options.body: Retain only approved persistence and lifecycle primitives while deferring CLI, Gateway, native-client, and broader delivery integration.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Do not adopt the durable runtime and schema contract on this release line, and re-scope or close dependent work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and harden
recommendation.body: Adopt the direction after the two exact-head defects, inspectable proof, upgrade safety, and owner-review gates are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal for the permanent contract is recent work on the canonical shared SQLite database, with repository-level CI and policy support from steipete.
